comment: POSTFIX-103 v0 rules. Silicon-measured minimum stall floors per dependency path on sm_103a (B300), consumer at the DIRECTLY next slot (d0) unless named. floor_global: rpath/P-carry ALU paths need S>=4 at d0 (S00..S03 physically insufficient @occupancy, S00 flaky everywhere). floor_dmix_d0: IMAD(.WIDE).X cout -> IADD3.X cin needs 5. floor_guard_d0: any P producer -> @P/@!P guard consumer needs 7. guard_d1_forbid: guard consumer with exactly one instruction between producer and consumer is FLAKY at every S<=8 (@occupancy) -- no stall legalizes it, the schedule itself is rejected. floor_guard_d2: guard at distance 3 needs 5. Stalls are a 4-bit field; cap_stall=11 is the BUG-036 policy cap (>=12 hangs measured kernels). Raise-only doctrine: the pass never lowers a stall, never touches B/R/W/Y bits.
